detail.longDescription:
🔁 FeedEcho v1.62.0: boost specific echoes instead of every echo to a Mastodon account.

Until now Boost was all-or-nothing per account. Each Mastodon echo now has its own Boost toggle on the Echoes page. The account-level setting still exists: while it's on, everything to that account gets boosted and the per-echo switch locks. Turn it back off and your per-echo picks resume.

Unchanged: only public and unlisted echoes get boosted (a boost would leak followers-only and direct posts), and @feedbooster@feedecho.net is still the account doing the announcing. Follow it to see the boosts in your timeline.

Release notes: https://github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho/releases/tag/v1.62.0

#FeedEcho #Mastodon #selfhosted
